description: This file contains functions and types for generating, parsing, and managing AI-generated quizzes, including API interactions, question parsing, and quiz data structures.

classes.name: QuizQuestion
classes.description: Represents a quiz question, either multiple-choice or open-ended, with options and optional explanation.

classes.name: AIQuizDocument
classes.description: Represents the structure of an AI-generated quiz stored in the database, including metadata and content.

classes.name: GetAIQuizResponse
classes.description: Type combining AIQuizDocument with associated questions, used for API responses.

classes.name: ListUserAiQuizzesQuery
classes.description: Parameters for querying a list of user quizzes.

classes.name: ListUserAiQuizzesResponse
classes.description: Response structure for a list of user quizzes.

methods.name: generateAIQuiz
methods.description: Main function to generate an AI quiz, handling API calls, streaming responses, and updating UI via callbacks.

methods.name: generateAiQuizQuestions
methods.description: Parses a string of question data into an array of QuizQuestion objects.

methods.name: aiQuizOptions
methods.description: Fetches a specific AI quiz by slug and returns its data with parsed questions.

methods.name: listUserAiQuizzesOptions
methods.description: Fetches a list of quizzes created by the user with pagination and query options.
